hebrewText: וְ/עָפ֨וּ בְ/כָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת בְּנֵי קֶ֑דֶם אֱד֤וֹם וּ/מוֹאָב֙ מִשְׁל֣וֹח יָדָ֔/ם וּ/בְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning)
tokens.kjv: brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away), [idiom] set, shine forth, weary.

tokens.bdb: the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything
a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanation: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanationEn: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.kjv: alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.
catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: the front, of place (absolutely, the fore part, relatively the East) or time (antiquity); often used adverbially (before, anciently, eastward)
tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).

tokens.bdb: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him
Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants
a sending out, i.e. (abstractly) presentation (favorable), or seizure (unfavorable); also (concretely) a place of dismissal, or a business to be discharged
tokens.kjv: to lay, to put, sending (forth), to set.

tokens.bdb: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),

tokens.explanation: yad — mão, força, poder, influência, autoridade
